source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U06: Apply sale-notice distinctions and inclusive purchaser-deposit arithmetic

payload.title: Separate first sale, repeat sale and the payment stages
payload.core_explanation_md:
The retained2016 amendment distinguishes the first immovable-property sale thirty-day rule from the not-less-than-fifteen-day subsequent-sale notice after a failed sale. The applicable service, affixing and publication requirements remain part of the process. Do not reuse a single unqualified period for every sale or confuse a possession notice with a sale notice.

The purchaser deposit is twenty-five per cent of the sale price, inclusive of earnest money already deposited, payable immediately on the same day or not later than the next working day as stated. The balance-payment rule and the permitted written extension must be checked separately; the amendment caps the described extension at three months. A private arrangement cannot be assumed to waive every statutory condition.

self_check.prompt_text: Should earnest money be added again on top of the inclusive25 per cent target?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Credit the qualifying amount already deposited.

payload.title: Credit earnest money once
payload.core_explanation_md: Stipulate an otherwise valid sale for INR 4,800,000 and INR 480,000 qualifying earnest money already paid. Calculate only the additional amount needed to reach the 25 per cent deposit.

self_check.prompt_text: Which rule and stipulated facts determine this result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Use the sourced rule and stated scenario assumptions; the arithmetic does not establish a live legal entitlement.

payload.stem_md: An otherwise valid immovable sale has a price of INR 5,600,000. INR 420,000 qualifying earnest money is already deposited. Using the inclusive25 per cent deposit rule, how much additional deposit is required in INR?
payload.correct_explanation_md: The target is5,600,000×25/100=1,400,000. Credit420,000 once; additional deposit=INR 980,000.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole units; do not round intermediate values.

payload.stem_md: A repeat sale after a failed first sale is documented using no new notice because the old notice was once published. What is required under the retained amendment?

options.text_md: No repeat-sale notice can ever be required
The applicable subsequent-sale notice of not less than fifteen days, with the required modes
options.explanation_md: Failure does not remove the repeat-sale safeguard.

options.text_md: Only a private telephone call to the buyer
options.explanation_md: That does not establish prescribed notice.

options.text_md: Automatically treat the first bid as final
options.explanation_md: The source does not support that shortcut.
